rt:param.name: SafetySystem
rt:param.comment: Это модуль СБ (будет обработка сигнала s14)

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub ErrCount() Dim ErrS As uint ErrS = 0 If (S0 == Nothing) || (S1 == Nothing) || (S3 == Nothing) Then Err = True Else If (S0 != nothing) Then ErrS = S0.Value & 0x1ff End If If (S1 != nothing) Then ErrS = ErrS | (S1.Value & 0x384) End If If (S3 != nothing) Then ErrS = ErrS | (S3.Value & 0xff) End If Err = (ErrS > 0) End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: If (KKS != "NULL") Then S0 = BIN(KKS + "_S0") S1 = BIN(KKS + "_S1") S3 = BIN(KKS + "_S3") End If

rect.rt:event: If S0 != nothing Then If VIS.ModelExists(False, "wd_TPTS_ZTT_6") Then Open_ws_wf_wi("wd_TPTS_ZTT_6", KKS + "|" + CStr(SafetySystem), False) ElseIf VIS.ModelExists(False, "wd_TPTS_ZTT_g2") Then Open_ws_wf_wi("wd_TPTS_ZTT_g2", KKS + "|" + CStr(SafetySystem), False) Else Open_ws_wf_wi("wd_TPTS_ZTT", KKS + "|" + CStr(SafetySystem), False) End If Else NoLink(KKS) End If

If S0 != nothing Then If VIS.ModelExists(False, "wd_TPTS_ZTT_6") Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|ZTTd|wd_TPTS_ZTT_6 " + KKS + "|" + CStr(SafetySystem)) ElseIf VIS.ModelExists(False, "wd_TPTS_ZTT_g2") Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|ZTTd|wd_TPTS_ZTT_g2 " + KKS + "|" + CStr(SafetySystem)) Else LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + "|ZTTd|wd_TPTS_ZTT " + KKS) End If Else NoLink(KKS) End If
